brief_title: Win streak reveal that lets the screen do the talking
hook_on_screen_text: We were NOT ready for this one

structure.beat: Cold open on the app with one line of text that promises a reveal
Scroll the wins board so the viewer sees real entries, not a mockup
The streak counter flips over and the number fills the screen
End card asks for a comment to get the link

cta: Comment WIN and I will send the link
product_or_topic_shown: A daily wins tracker app, recorded on a phone screen
why_it_worked: The first line promises a payoff and the screen recording pays it off before anyone can scroll away. The top comments ask what app this is, so the product was the story, not a tip about the product.
transferable_mechanism: promise a number reveal in the first line, then show the real screen that produces the number
adaptation_for_product: swap the wins board for the Sprout streak screen and reveal the day count right after a check-in, keeping the same one line tease
avoid: The generic five habit apps you need listicle that every account in this niche already posts
